brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors detected; all RC items met with safe, evidence-based guidance. Multiple high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact through verification of ambiguous results, correction of patient misconceptions, and repair of responsibility-chain gaps. All five dimensions rated good or excellent. Closure is valid with safe executable plan and patient receipt confirmed.
